internal.reason: Companion iterative-zone tutorial — Repeat Zone threads geometry state across N iterations; Accumulate Field threads a running scalar across N points. Different mechanisms, same philosophy of per-element stateful computation.
Scene Time is the shared driver: in the Simulation Zone it advances one frame per tick; here it is sampled uniformly per point for independent offset timing.

Both tutorials expose advanced GN field evaluation — Index of Nearest uses topology distance; Accumulate Field uses sorted running sums. Together they show the range of per-element computation available without Simulation Zone overhead.

Interpolate Domain is the complementary cross-domain field transfer node; Accumulate Field is the intra-domain running-sum node. Pair them to produce face-level stagger delays from vertex-level position data.
The staggered-reveal GLB export is directly usable as an animated capture rig marker field for Gaussian Splatting shoots — pillars rising to mark capture positions one by one.
